headline: Rashad Next
caption:
Khamzat Chimaev's first RAF title defense is set, and it's against UFC Hall of Famer Rashad Evans.
Chimaev or Evans? 👇

Chimaev puts his RAF Light Heavyweight Crossover belt on the line vs. the 47-year-old former UFC champion in the RAF 16 main event on Dec 19 on Long Island. Fans have pushed back on the matchup online.

🔥 Hot take: Rashad was a great wrestler, but 47 vs. prime Khamzat is a mismatch.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
question: Chimaev or Evans?
